answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 145541 Country: India Title: How to calculate zakat on gold ornaments? Question: Please shed some light on how to calculate zakah on gold ornaments. (1) Whether we should consider the consider total weight * current price or (2) Get the selling price of the ornament and accordingly pay the zakah [as the jeweler will deduct some percentage in gold as impurity]. Answer ID: 145541 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 71/89/M=2/1438) The adulteration in gold or silver ornaments is counted with the original gold and silver as it is generally very less; therefore while weighing and fixing its price both the original and adulteration shall be calculated together. It is better to consider the price on which the jeweler sells and calculate the fortieth part of the all ornaments as zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
